visualCharacteristics.summary: Single-line trail under the header: linked ancestors separated by chevrons, current page as plain text, thin bottom rule.

contentPattern.structure: One cell with a list of links (Home, Section, ...), last item plain text for the current page. Paragraphs of links separated by '>' also work; an empty block derives the trail from the URL. An optional picture becomes a background.

usage: Site-wide breadcrumb under the header on almost every page (1700+ pages). image-light is for a trail rendered over or directly above a hero photo; alt is the compact trail without a bottom rule.

suitableFor: every interior page, directly after the header
